For one geology student, it meant spending eight months at McArthur River learning about the mining process while contributing to the operation in meaningful ways. Beyond the technical experience, one of their biggest takeaways was the opportunity to learn from people across the site and gain exposure to many different areas of the business. Their advice to students considering Cameco? Apply. You'll work alongside people who care about your safety, want to see you succeed and are willing to share their knowledge every step of the way.
